meta.title: Digital signage player download — Android, desktop
meta.description: Digital signage player download for Android or desktop. Install the SignageWall player and pair a screen in seconds.

hero.title: Download the digital signage player.
hero.subtitle: A lightweight app that turns any TV or computer into a smart screen. Install it, enter the pairing code, and the screen is ready.

platforms.title: Choose your platform.

android.name: Android
android.body: For Android TV, TV boxes and Android devices. Ideal for screens around your space.

desktop.name: Desktop
desktop.body: For Windows and macOS computers and mini-PCs connected to a screen.

platforms.unavailableNote: The build is not public yet. Get in touch and we will send it to you.

items.title: Install
items.body: Download and run the SignageWall player on the device connected to your screen — an Android box, a mini PC, or a computer already sitting nearby. Nothing else has to be installed, and no server is involved.

items.title: Pair
items.body: The player shows a short pairing code on the screen. Enter it in the Screens section of your dashboard and the device is linked to one logical screen in your account. No cables are moved and nobody has to visit the site again.

items.title: Publish
items.body: Send content from the dashboard and the screen picks it up within seconds. From then on the player stores what it downloaded and keeps playing it through a dropped connection, syncing again the moment the network returns.

note: No account yet? Get in touch and we will help you set up your first screen. The trial runs for 21 days with every feature switched on and needs no card, so a first screen can be running before you decide anything.
